# @gentbo/cache

> 标签: browser-storage, cache, expiration, frontend, gentbo, javascript, localstorage, namespace, storage, web-cache

## 简介

A lightweight JavaScript browser cache management library with localStorage persistence, expiration control, and namespace support.
